situations.headline: Aureka (AKA) enters binding scrip-heavy deal for Fiddlers Creek mine & Wedderburn mill, funded by $5.65m placement + SPP

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Aureka (AKA) enters binding scrip-heavy deal for Fiddlers Creek mine & Wedderburn mill, funded by $5.65m placement + SPP (interest 6, risk 5)

thesis.text: Aureka is transitioning from explorer to producer via a low-cash, majority-scrip acquisition of a proximate operating mine and licensed mill, potentially unlocking processing margin and optionality for its Irvine and Comstock projects; near-term catalysts are shareholder approval and Completion (End Date ~3 months post-signing), with contingent production milestones providing a read on operational execution over the following 12-36 months.
